setup_steps.text: Sign in to your Intuit Developer account at https://developer.intuit.com/dashboard.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Sign in to your developer account.

setup_steps.text: Navigate to My Hub > App dashboard from the upper-right corner toolbar.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Select My Hub > App dashboard from the upper-right corner of the toolbar.

setup_steps.text: Select the app card with a '+' to create a new application.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Select the app card with a + to create a new app.

setup_steps.text: Follow the on-screen creation flow and configure scopes (such as accounting or payments) based on the data your app needs.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: When you create apps, you'll pick your app's scopes. Scopes limit the type of data your app can access.

setup_steps.text: In your app's settings/keys section, add your OAuth 2.0 Redirect URI (for example, the OAuth2 Playground URL or your callback URL).
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: navigating to your app -> keys section and setting the Redirect URI

setup_steps.text: Retrieve your Client ID and Client Secret from your app dashboard to use for OAuth 2.0 authentication.
setup_steps.label: Sourced
setup_steps.quote: Use your credentials (i.e., Client ID and Client Secret) to connect your app to OAuth 2.0.

setup_steps.text: If connecting via custom credentials in Composio, enter the Client ID and Client Secret into your Composio app settings.
setup_steps.label: Inferred
setup_steps.note: Standard integration step when bringing your own OAuth credentials into Composio.
